Method/Read preprocessing

Amplicon primer trimming

Remove primer sequence from amplicon-based reads using a primer scheme.

When to use this method

Use when

  • The library was made with tiled amplicons, such as ARTIC-style schemes.
  • You have the BED file for the exact primer scheme and version used.

Skip this method when

  • The library is shotgun, so there are no primers to remove.
  • The primer scheme or its version is unknown, since trimming with the wrong scheme leaves primer sequence behind.

Combine with

  • Quality and adapter trimming: Apply it first to remove adapters and low-quality bases, which primer trimming does not fully address.

Operation

Read preprocessing

Implementations

  • iVar trim

Needs

Raw reads or Clean reads, Primer scheme, Reference genome

Produces

Clean reads

Primer-binding sites reflect the primer sequence, not the sample, so primer sequence must be removed before calling variants. Reads are mapped to the reference, and primer positions from the scheme are soft-clipped.

Used by protocols

Specified by

  • Viral phylogenomic surveillanceStep 1

Other methods for this operation

  • Quality and adapter trimmingTrim adapter sequence and low-quality bases from reads.
